pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the letter S named in German? (1 mark)
   A. enn
   B. tset
   C. ess
   D. emm

2. How is the letter Q named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ee
   B. koo
   C. emm
   D. fow

3. Which day comes right after Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Samstag
   C. Dienstag
   D. Sonntag

4. What does "der Topf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. plate
   B. pot
   C. bathroom
   D. clock

5. Which German word means "to have a shower"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. duschen
   B. hören
   C. lernen
   D. riechen

6. What does "die Sonne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. wind
   C. snow
   D. thunderstorm

7. Which German word is the number 17? (1 mark)
   A. siebzehn
   B. elf
   C. zwei
   D. sieben

8. Which German word means "cold"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. neblig
   B. heiß
   C. wolkig
   D. kalt

9. What does "Und dir?" mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. And who?
   C. And me?
   D. And where?

10. Which German word or phrase means "no"? (1 mark)
   A. Sehr gut
   B. Nein
   C. Hallo
   D. Auf Wiedersehen

11. What does "der zehnte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. second
   B. tenth
   C. fourth
   D. fifth

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Woche"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

13. Which German word or phrase means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Samstag
   B. der Donnerstag
   C. der Montag
   D. der Sonntag

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Schlafzimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

15. What does "hören" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to hear
   B. to read
   C. to speak
   D. to play

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

18. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

20. Write the seven days of the week in German in order, starting with Monday. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — ess
   In German the letter S is called ess.

2. B — koo
   In German the letter Q is called koo.

3. B — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

4. B — pot
   der Topf means pot.

5. A — duschen
   to have a shower in German is duschen.

6. A — sun
   die Sonne means sun.

7. A — siebzehn
   17 in German is siebzehn.

8. D — kalt
   cold in German is kalt.

9. A — And you?
   Und dir? asks the same question back.

10. B — Nein
   no in German is Nein.

11. B — tenth
   der zehnte means tenth.

12. A — die
   It is die Woche, so the little word is die.

13. C — der Montag
   Monday in German is der Montag.

14. A — das
   It is das Schlafzimmer, so the little word is das.

15. A — to hear
   hören means to hear.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all seven correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.
